anchors.description: Sheet of white paper lying on the dark carpet at the lower left, long top edge between two crisp corners
anchors.visible_evidence: Bright white rectangular paper sheet (with a bent/folded corner) on the dark red carpet near the bottom-left; its long top edge runs between two sharp corners about 82 px apart, nearly parallel to the image x-axis so foreshortening is mild.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: US Letter (0.279 m) vs A4 (0.297 m) cannot be distinguished; several overlapping sheets and one bent corner make corner localization uncertain by a few pixels; could conceivably be a thin folder.

anchors.description: Closed white six-panel interior door left of the bookcase, left and right stiles visible as straight vertical edges
anchors.visible_evidence: Closed white paneled door; both vertical stiles are visible from the image top down to the floor line at y~275, so two points at the same image height on the two stiles bound the full door leaf width (3D chord between the parallel edges equals leaf width).
anchors.identity_uncertainty: US interior door leaf widths are typically 28-36 in (0.71-0.91 m), most commonly 30 or 32 in; whether the visible right edge is the leaf edge or the adjacent jamb adds a few cm of uncertainty.
